'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Mark Peterson LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / General Kenobi]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
